markets.rules_primary:
If 
 Donald Trump says Ukraine as part of Tele-Rally with Darline Graham
, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Video of the Tele-Rally with Darline Graham using the live broadcast or stream.
If a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, internal & external (official) transcripts of the Tele-Rally with Darline Graham will be used.

Payout Criteria
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word. 
Plural nouns occurring within proper nouns and noun phrases (e.g. names, titles, etc).
Donald Trump speaking in an official capacity.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.

Doesn't count for payout
Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. 
Additional content not included in the original call will not count.
The entirety of content within the original call will be used for resolution.

Payout for cancellations and delays
If an event is definitively cancelled or the event fails to qualify under the Payout Criterion, or any other circumstance prevents normal resolution, then the market for "Event does not qualify" resolves to Yes and all other markets will resolve to No.  
If the event is postponed, and such a postponement is announced by the end of the following calendar day to be rescheduled to a time within 14 calendar days, the markets shall remain open.
markets.title: What will Donald Trump say during Tele-Rally with Darline Graham?

If 
 Donald Trump says Transgender as part of Tele-Rally with Mike Mazzei
, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Video of the Tele-Rally with Mike Mazzei using the live broadcast or stream.
If a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, internal & external (official) transcripts of the Tele-Rally with Mike Mazzei will be used.

Payout Criteria
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word. 
Plural nouns occurring within proper nouns and noun phrases (e.g. names, titles, etc).
Donald Trump speaking in an official capacity.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.

Doesn't count for payout
Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. 
Additional content not included in the original call will not count.
The entirety of content within the original call will be used for resolution.

Payout for cancellations and delays
If an event is definitively cancelled or the event fails to qualify under the Payout Criterion, or any other circumstance prevents normal resolution, then the market for "Event does not qualify" resolves to Yes and all other markets will resolve to No.  
If the event is postponed, and such a postponement is announced by the end of the following calendar day to be rescheduled to a time within 14 calendar days, the markets shall remain open.

markets.rules_primary: If the value of the USDCAD opening candlestick is Above 1.399 at 5pm ET on Aug 28, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The market resolves based on the open value of the USDCAD exchange rate as published by Pyth at 5pm ET on Aug 28, 2026. If the rate is Above 1.399 at that time, the market resolves to Yes. If not, the market resolves to No. Revisions to the underlying made after expiration will not be accounted for in determining the Expiration Value.

Rounding to four decimal places shall be assumed unless otherwise specified.

If no data is available from Pyth at the specified time, the most recently available value will be used.

markets.rules_primary:
If 
 Donald Trump says Tuition as part of Rose Garden Event
, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Video of the Rose Garden Event using the live broadcast or stream.
If a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, internal & external (official) transcripts of the Rose Garden Event will be used.

Payout Criteria
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word. 
Plural nouns occurring within proper nouns and noun phrases (e.g. names, titles, etc).
Donald Trump speaking in an official capacity.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.

Doesn't count for payout
Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. 
Presence alone during a livestream is not sufficient for the market to qualify (e.g., inaudible private conversations on camera, unofficial statements picked up on a hot mic).
Except as otherwise specified, previously aired content, archival footage, and recordings captured at times, places, or events wholly separate from the featured address.

Payout for cancellations and delays
If an event is definitively cancelled or the event fails to qualify under the Payout Criterion, or any other circumstance prevents normal resolution, then the market for "Event does not qualify" resolves to Yes and all other markets will resolve to No.  
If the event is postponed, and such a postponement is announced by the end of the following calendar day to be rescheduled to a time within 14 calendar days, the markets shall remain open.
